In this setting we group each document's text into paragraphs of at most 400 tokens and rank them using our TF-IDF heuristic.

tables.caption: Examples from SQuAD where a paragraph-level model was less confident in a correct extraction from one paragraph (left) than in an incorrect extraction from another (right). Even if the passage has no correct answer, the model still assigns high confidence to phrases that match the category the question is asking about. Because the confidence scores are not well-calibrated, this confidence is often higher than the confidence assigned to the correct answer span.
